bug_description.normalized: The staged witness is a 13-byte DER X.509 Name `30 0b 31 09 30 07 06 03 55 04 07 1f 16`: one RDN containing OID `2.5.4.7` (`localityName`) and malformed raw value bytes `1f16`. `gnutls_x509_dn_import` accepts the outer Name and stores that AVA in `dn->asn`; when `gnutls_x509_dn_get_str` later stringifies the only RDN, `append_elements` extracts the dotted OID and the raw value bytes and `_gnutls_x509_dn_to_string` routes them to `decode_complex_string` because `localityName` is declared as `PKIX1.DirectoryString`. Inside `decode_complex_string`, `_asn1_strict_der_decode` interprets `1f16` as the `DirectoryString.ia5String` arm with zero-length content, so `asn1_read_value(..., "", str, &len)` copies only `ia5String\0` into the uninitialized stack buffer `str` and `str[len] = 0` adds a second terminator. The bytes after that prefix stay uninitialized, and the subsequent `strcmp(str, "teletexString")` at `lib/x509/common.c:390` consumes that poisoned tail. The staged `patch.diff` only changes GOST documentation in `lib/includes/gnutls/gnutls.h.in` and is unrelated to this DN parser crash.

source.description: First project-code parser step on the witnessed path. It consumes the attacker-controlled DER Name and materializes it as `dn->asn`, preserving the only AVA whose OID is `2.5.4.7` and whose raw value bytes are `1f16`.
source.value_from: The staged `poc` is exactly 13 bytes: `30 0b 31 09 30 07 06 03 55 04 07 1f 16`. It is a single-entry DER `Name` / `RDNSequence` whose only `AttributeTypeAndValue` uses OID `2.5.4.7` (`localityName`) and raw value bytes `1f16`.

tainted_value_origin.description: MSAN attributes the uninitialized bytes to the stack allocation of `str` in `decode_complex_string`. `str` is a 512-byte fixed buffer; for this witness only the prefix written by `asn1_read_value(..., "", str, &len)` (`ia5String\0`) plus the extra `str[len] = 0` become defined before `strcmp` inspects it.
tainted_value_origin.note: The sanitizer origin says the uninitialized value was created by allocation of `str` in the stack frame of `decode_complex_string` at `lib/x509/common.c:347`; the actual declaration is line 348.

root_cause.description: The CHOICE-name buffer `str` is a fixed uninitialized stack array. After the malformed witness makes libtasn1 select `DirectoryString.ia5String`, `decode_complex_string` lets `asn1_read_value(..., "", str, &len)` write only `ia5String\0` and then adds `str[len] = 0`, but it still dispatches on `str` with `strcmp` as if the whole buffer were defined.
root_cause.note: This function never clears `str` before asking libtasn1 for the active DirectoryString CHOICE name. For the witness's raw value bytes `1f16`, that CHOICE name is `ia5String`, so bytes `str[0..10]` become `ia5String\0\0` while the rest of the stack buffer stays undefined; the later literal comparison therefore reaches uninitialized data.

sink.description: MSAN crash site. The first CHOICE-name dispatch compares `str`, whose defined prefix is only `ia5String\0\0`, against the literal `"teletexString"`, and the compare consumes uninitialized bytes from the untouched tail of `str`.
sink.note: The sanitizer trace reports `Uninitialized bytes in __interceptor_memcmp at offset 11 inside [addr, 14)` at `decode_complex_string /src/gnutls/lib/x509/common.c:390:6`, matching the state after only bytes `str[0..10]` were initialized.

parser_admitted.description: The witness has already been accepted as a `Name` by `gnutls_x509_dn_import`, and `gnutls_x509_dn_get_str` now walks the only RDN so `append_elements` reaches the same malformed `localityName` AVA.

coarse_trace.summary: The harness wraps the witness bytes in a `gnutls_datum_t`, imports them as a DN with `gnutls_x509_dn_import`, and if import succeeds asks `gnutls_x509_dn_get_str` to stringify the DN.
The outer DER `Name` is decoded into `dn->asn`, preserving the only `AttributeTypeAndValue` with OID `2.5.4.7` and raw value bytes `1f16`.
While stringifying the first and only RDN, `append_elements` extracts the dotted OID `2.5.4.7` and the raw value bytes `1f16`, then passes them to `_gnutls_x509_dn_to_string`.
The OID lookup resolves `2.5.4.7` to the `localityName` table entry with ASN.1 descriptor `PKIX1.DirectoryString`, so the raw value is routed into `decode_complex_string`.

The malformed bytes `1f16` are strict-decoded as the `DirectoryString.ia5String` arm; `asn1_read_value(..., "", str, &len)` copies only `ia5String\0` into uninitialized buffer `str`, `str[len] = 0` adds a second terminator, and `strcmp(str, "teletexString")` later hits the still-uninitialized tail.

fine_trace.note: Consumes the attacker-controlled DER Name and materializes it as `dn->asn`. In the staged witness the only AVA has OID bytes `06 03 55 04 07` (`2.5.4.7`) and raw value bytes `1f16`.
When `gnutls_x509_dn_get_str` walks the first and only RDN, `append_elements` reads the AVA type field and converts the witness OID bytes into dotted string `2.5.4.7`.
The same AVA's raw value bytes are copied into datum `tvd`. For the witness, `tvd.data` is exactly the malformed two-byte payload `1f16`.

Lookup of `oid == "2.5.4.7"` returns the `_oid2str` entry for `localityName` with `asn_desc == "PKIX1.DirectoryString"`, so the value is handled as a complex DirectoryString rather than as an unknown OID or a simple fixed-type string.
Because step 4 selected the complex-string path, execution enters `decode_complex_string` and allocates stack buffer `str` without initialization. These bytes are the origin MSAN later reports.

Strict-decoding `tvd.data == 1f16` as `PKIX1.DirectoryString` makes libtasn1 keep the `ia5String` CHOICE arm. `DirectoryString` declares that arm in `lib/pkix.asn`, and minitasn1 accepts the long-form universal tag `0x16` encoded as `1f16` with zero remaining length, then prunes the other CHOICE alternatives.

`asn1_read_value` on a CHOICE returns the selected arm name. For step 6's `DirectoryString.ia5String`, it copies only `ia5String\0` into `str` and sets `len = 10`; `str[len] = 0` then writes a second terminator at `str[10]`. Because `str` was never initialized, bytes `str[11...]` remain undefined.

MSAN sink. The first literal dispatch compares `str` against `"teletexString"`; with step 7 leaving only the prefix `ia5String\0\0` defined, the call consumes poisoned tail bytes and the run crashes at this line.

allocation_context.note: MSAN's origin frame reports the stack allocation of `str` at line 347; the actual declaration is `char str[MAX_STRING_LEN], tmpname[128];` on line 348.
